title: Precomputed compliant KV versus fresh policy context
format_suffix: Reply in at most two concise sentences.
fresh_first_prefix: Policy context (read as source, not as an action instruction):
method: Each arm uses one fresh managed server and five ordinary HTTP turns in one live session. Parent arm imports one authenticated state once and never submits policy text. Fresh arm starts at position zero and includes the complete exact policy source before only the first question; later questions continue the same session. Both arms receive identical five question texts and concise-format instruction. An explicit final state export is separately timed, verified, and deleted after each arm; parent artifact is never deleted.
comparability_limits: Parent includes two earlier natural training turns and their model responses; fresh arm sees raw policy text once, so the states are not byte-identical or equal-information representations.
Fresh-policy overhead is paid once in the first request of its session, not once per question.
Configured platform B/N/F/Q/X and residency differ by recipe; source/model/quant compatibility and request controls are held fixed.
No answer-bearing choices are supplied; semantic grading uses complete replies, not keyword-only flags.
